name: zombicide-fantasy-map-editor
description: Éditeur local et CLI de missions Zombicide Fantasy

scripts.check: node --check app/scripts/data.js && node --check app/scripts/token.js && node --check app/scripts/editor.js && node --check app/scripts/catalog-editor.js && node --check cli/dev-server.mjs && node --check cli/zombicide-map.mjs
scripts.validate:example: node cli/zombicide-map.mjs validate examples/mission.json --collection examples/collection.json --catalog examples/catalog.json
scripts.render:example: node cli/zombicide-map.mjs render examples/mission.json --collection examples/collection.json --catalog examples/catalog.json --output examples/mission.svg
